title: KYC verification runbook
markdown:
# KYC verification runbook

## How investor verification works
- Limited partners submit onboarding data through digital subscription documents.
- Information is automatically passed to our KYC/AML verification vendor for screening.
- The system waits for a pass, fail, or manual review flag from the vendor.

## Vendor hand-off
- Payload is sent via API to the vendor upon investor form submission.
- Webhooks return status updates to Anduin.
- If the vendor API is unreachable, events queue for retry.

## What to check when LPs are stuck in pending
- Check the vendor dashboard for unverified identity documents or name mismatches.
- Verify if the investor is flagged for a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) or sanctions match requiring manual compliance review.
- Confirm whether the fund administrator or law firm needs to clear an AML exception.

title: Escalation policy and severity levels
markdown:
# Escalation policy and severity levels

## Severity levels
- Sev 1: Complete platform outage or major data sync failure impacting all fund managers.
- Sev 2: Core feature degradation, such as e-signature or KYC vendor hand-off failing for multiple users.
- Sev 3: Isolated investor portal issues or delayed capital call notices affecting a single fund.
- Sev 4: Minor UI bugs, general questions, or feature requests.

## Who to page
- Sev 1: Page the on-call engineer and notify engineering leadership immediately.
- Sev 2: Page the secondary on-call engineer during business hours.
- Sev 3 and Sev 4: Handled via standard ticketing queue without paging.

## Response targets
- Response targets and specific timeframes are not recorded.

## Customer communication rules
- Keep fund managers informed with status updates during Sev 1 incidents.
- Do not share internal vendor failure specifics with limited partners; coordinate messaging with the fund manager.

title: Data room permissions guide
markdown:
# Data room permissions guide

## Overview
This guide outlines how permissions are granted in the data room to limited partners (LPs), legal counsel, and fund administrators within Anduin.

## Granting Permissions
- LPs: Access is granted at the investor profile level, linking their authenticated portal user to specific subscription documents and capital notices.
- Counsel: Law firms are granted access to specific fund documents, subscription packets, and KYC/AML verification records based on their engagement scope.
- Administrators: Fund administrators receive broad data room access to facilitate data syncs, investor onboarding verification, and reporting.

## Common Mistakes
- Assigning incorrect permission tiers to external law firm counsel, occasionally exposing multi-fund data instead of single-fund documents.
- Forgetting to revoke data room access for LPs who have fully transferred or redeemed their fund interests.
- Granting administrative sync permissions to standard LP user profiles by accident.

- [ ] Audit all active counsel permissions for closed funds
- [ ] Update internal checklist for administrator onboarding
